title: The Witch's Attic
intro: Bundles of herbs hang from the rafters. Spiders have woven a second ceiling. A trunk wrapped in chains sits under the one window of the attic.

objects.label: Spider Web
objects.reward_text: The web shivers. Something very large drops from the rafters.

a_herbs: Try assuming the first speaker is a knight and follow what that forces. If you hit a contradiction, they are a knave.
A statement from a knave must be FALSE. Negate it to learn something certain.
The knights are Drusilla. The code is D. The vault's character number 1 is 6.
b_broomstick: There are 6 stones, so the number of ways to pick any pair is 6 x 5 / 2 = 15.
Count the pairs that give the wanted outcome, then divide by the total number of pairs.
The probability is 3/5. The vault's character number 2 is V.
c_statue: You need exactly (width) steps right and (height) steps up, in some order.
The number of routes is the number of ways to choose which steps are 'right'.
That is C(11, 6), the number of ways to choose 6 items from 11.
The answer is 462. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are 5 and N.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Hanging Herbs, Old Broomstick, Black Cat Statue.
